title: Hearty Molten Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A rich and flavorful stew featuring caramelized sugar sauce and tender beef, inspired by the earthy flavors of Uruguay
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside
Add the onion to the pot and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes
Add the garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute
Add the brown sugar to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the beef broth, red wine, tomato paste, oregano, salt, and pepper to the pot
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven, cooking at 300 degrees for 2 1/2 hours
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool slightly before serving
